name: PLEASURE☆
source:
Watase Tooru has been scouted because of his basketball talent and will be attending a school full of famous athletes. However, what awaits him is something he never saw coming.

What will become of Tooru when he finds himself thrown into a world full of lust, sex, and basketball?
translation:
渡濑彻因篮球天赋而被星探发掘，并将就读于一所充满著名运动员的学校。然而，等待他的却是他从未预料到的事情。

当透发现自己被扔进一个充满欲望、性和篮球的世界时，他会变成什么样子？
